standards.applies_because: No harmonised surfboard standard: the General Product Safety Regulation applies

standards.citation_note: Standard to be confirmed (edition and applicability) — no verified citation URL

risks.risk: Board snaps or creases under a heavy landing
risks.mitigation: Stringer or carbon rail bands; 3-point bending test on coupons and full board
Pull-out test on the fin system, reinforcement patch under the box

risks.risk: Delamination and water ingress into the core
risks.mitigation: Vent plug (EPS), vacuum-bagged laminate, sealed inserts

risks.risk: Too little volume for the rider → hard paddling, late planing
risks.mitigation: Size volume from rider weight and level (litres per kg guideline)
UV-stabilised epoxy, hot coat with UV blocker

tests.name: 3-point flex of laminate coupons and full board
tests.method: Load-deflection to failure on coupons; proof load on a board

tests.name: Fin box pull-out
tests.method: Pull along the fin axis to failure

tests.name: Drop / impact on rails (ding resistance)
tests.method: Falling-weight impact on rail and deck

tests.name: Water absorption after 24 h immersion
tests.method: Weigh before/after with a pierced laminate patch

tests.name: Salt-water + UV exposure of fittings
tests.method: Inserts and plugs, visual + pull-out after exposure

cost_lines.item: Enclosure: CNC-shaped EPS blank + hand-laid epoxy/glass (per litre)

assembly_steps: Export the outline and rocker from the CAD to the shaping machine
CNC-shape an EPS blank, hand-finish rails
Laminate epoxy/glass (4+4 oz deck, 4 oz bottom), install fin boxes and vent plug
Weigh the finished board, check volume by water displacement
Test-ride with two rider weights and log speed with a GPS watch

total_cost.label: estimate
total_cost.source_or_assumption: Sum of the prototype cost lines

build_strategy.title: Full design
build_strategy.explanation: You design the whole product: every part, the BOM and (if any) the simple electronics are yours, and a factory builds to your CAD and drawings. This is how mechanical products and simple electronics are made.
not_customisable: Foam blanks, fin boxes, fins from suppliers
